name: standard-clearing
description: Deterministic auto-insurance quote estimates. Compare car-insurance rates across major carriers (State Farm, GEICO, Progressive, Allstate, Liberty Mutual, USAA and more) using published SERFF rate filings. Gathers a driver/vehicle profile conversationally and returns per-carrier monthly price ranges with uncertainty, not marketing leads.
